# directus_preset (Resource)

Manages a Directus preset — a saved bookmark or default collection view (directus_presets).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `bookmark` (String) Bookmark name. Empty for a collection default view.
- `collection` (String) Collection the preset targets.
- `color` (String) Accent color (hex) for the bookmark.
- `filter` (String) Filter rules as a JSON object.
- `icon` (String) Material icon name for the bookmark.
- `layout` (String) Layout id (e.g. tabular, cards).
- `layout_options` (String) Per-layout display options as a JSON object.
- `layout_query` (String) Per-layout query state as a JSON object.
- `refresh_interval` (Number) Auto-refresh interval in seconds.
- `role` (String) UUID of the role this preset applies to (omit for global).
- `search` (String) Search query stored in the preset.
- `user` (String) UUID of the user this preset applies to (omit for global).

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Server-assigned preset id.
